documents.doc-cz-ms-pha-2026-09-23-18-a-23-2026-18: On 23 September 2026, under ref. 18 A 23/2026-182, the Prague Municipal Court sent the claimant, for information, the defendant Ministry of Justice's statement concerning the action, dated 27 August 2026. The Court set a one-week period from service of the covering letter for any reply. It also stated that it treats the case as a priority matter, but not as an extraordinarily urgent one. The uploaded PDF contains the Court's covering letter only, not the defendant's attached statement. Because the date of service is not evidenced in the document, no specific calendar deadline is inferred.
